title: QA senior lead
description:
QA Senior Lead (Contract/FTE) Experience: 11–15 Years Company \- LTI Mindtree Location: Kolkata Budget: As per Market Standards Role Overview We are looking for a QA Senior Lead to lead quality assurance for a large\-scale, cloud\-native media content platform handling massive volumes of media data including articles, videos, and audio. The role will focus on API testing, data validation, automation, performance testing, and QA strategy, while leading the team and driving quality across the complete data lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor QA engineers and define the overall QA strategy. Drive Shift\-Left testing and integrate quality practices across the SDLC. Own end\-to\-end testing for data ingestion, processing, storage, and API consumption. Test ingestion workflows, SNS/SQS, scheduled jobs, and REST APIs including keyword, category, and semantic search. Perform large\-scale validation of JSON datasets using AWS S3, Athena, SQL, and Glue Crawlers. Validate metadata, mappings, date logic, filtering, and data accuracy across multiple sources. Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks using JavaScript/Jest and/or Python/Pytest. Integrate API automation and JSON schema validation into CI/CD pipelines. Design and execute high\-volume load and performance testing using Locust. Analyse bottlenecks across ALB, ECS, downstream services, API latency, and search performance. Build and monitor QA/observability dashboards using New Relic and OpenSearch. Maintain test strategies, edge cases, performance reports, and QA documentation in Confluence. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and other stakeholders to resolve complex issues. Technical Skills Mandatory: API / Microservices Testing REST Assured REST APIs \& JSON validation Strong backend/API automation experience JavaScript and/or Python AWS \& Cloud: AWS S3, Lambda, API Gateway ECS, ALB, SQS, SNS Athena, Glue Crawlers OpenSearch / Elasticsearch Testing \& Automation: API \& Microservices Testing Automation Framework Development Jest / Pytest Locust for Load \& Performance Testing CI/CD pipelines and AWS CodeBuild Good to Have AWS Bedrock / Cohere AI\-powered semantic search and embeddings Vector\-based retrieval / Vector Databases Docker \& Kubernetes Contract Testing / Service Virtualization Graph Databases LLM\-based test case generation Key Requirements Proven experience as a QA Lead / Senior QA Engineer handling distributed systems and large\-scale data/ETL pipelines. Strong experience in API automation, data validation, and performance testing. Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills. Strong stakeholder communication and team mentoring experience. Ability to work in a dynamic, cross\-functional environment. Share CVs at: hrtrinexglobal@gmail.com

Pay: Up to ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
